subject: doc
title: (R)DOC.------TRS.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 286 (PR.S(RD)II-40). DOC (documentation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and ROTP (responsibility of the position). From COS-P: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From TH-CONT: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From EXP-DY: EXP-CONT-2 (expansion condition (isolated focus)). From EXP-CONT-2: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From ROTP: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: MT-INFO-DB.
